descriptions.session_setup: Session construction incl. Qwen streaming prompt prefill
descriptions.session_push: One Stage11Session.push call over a 160 ms ingress chunk
descriptions.source_runtime: Stage09 chunk-causal source frontend (mel + Emformer + CTC + B1 + policy)
descriptions.src_mel_spectrogram: torchaudio MelSpectrogram over the cumulative waveform
descriptions.src_feature_projection: log-mel stacking and input projection (extract_projected minus mel)
descriptions.src_encoder_infer: Emformer.infer on the 160 ms segment plus 80 ms right context
descriptions.src_ctc_head: CTC head linear projections (source and target)
descriptions.src_b1_bridge: B1 bridge: Emformer hidden -> Qwen GLM embedding space
descriptions.qwen_prefill_source: Qwen KV-cache append of START_GLM + source embeddings + END_GLM
descriptions.qwen_prefill_wait: Qwen KV-cache append of a single WAIT token
descriptions.qwen_ar_decode: Qwen autoregressive WRITE generation (text + 50 Hz BiCodec semantic)
descriptions.qwen_forward_ids: Qwen forward over discrete ids with KV cache
descriptions.qwen_forward_embeds: Qwen forward over continuous source embeddings with KV cache
descriptions.logits_repetition_penalty: Repetition penalty over the full expanded vocabulary
descriptions.parse_write_tokens: Parsing one WRITE into text ids and semantic values
descriptions.codec_stream_push: Streaming BiCodec wrapper (window selection, holdback, crossfade)
descriptions.codec_vocoder: BiCodec detokenize over the left-context window
descriptions.result_io: Final WAV/JSON writing and stereo alignment
descriptions.offline_fallback: Final-only offline safety generation when no WRITE was accepted
